sourceName: NAVIGA-AD Internet Orders Starter W/ GL Revenue
vaultSummary: Report splitting revenue into GL buckets based on GL overrides.

fields.label: Campaign ID
fields.description: Campaign Identifier

fields.label: Line ID
fields.description: Line Identifier.  Campaigns will have multiple lines and lines will have multiple line details

fields.label: Month Actual Amt
fields.description: Used to calculate the GL Net/Gross amounts.

fields.label: Month Est Amt
fields.description: Used to calculate the GL Net/Gross amounts.

fields.label: Month End Date
fields.description: The ending date of the Order details record.

fields.label: Month Start Date
fields.description:
Can be considered the Issue date for a Print publication. 
The starting date of the Order details record.

fields.label: No Agy Comm Ind
fields.description: Used to determine if Agency commission is to be applied.

fields.label: Product ID
fields.description: Product Identifier

fields.label: Print Pub Ind
fields.description:
Y = Print publication
N = Digital Publication

fields.label: Product
fields.description: Product Name

fields.label: Campaign Date Entered
fields.description: Date that the campaign was entered into the system.

fields.label: Campaign Type
fields.description:
M = Performance Campaign
F = Flexible Campaign

fields.label: Campaign Status Code
fields.description:
Only these status' are included in results
IS = Invoice Started
CO = Confirmed
R* = Reserved (can have multiple codes R1, R2, etc)

fields.label: Gross Line Local Amount
fields.description: Total Gross Revenue (including Agency Commission) before GL percentage application.

fields.label: Net Line Local Amount
fields.description: Total Net Revenue (excluding Agency Commission) before GL percentage application.

fields.label: Real Gl Code
fields.description: GL Code this Revenue is assigned to.

fields.label: Gl Percent
fields.description: If the Line detail revenue is split across GL's this designates the percent allocated to this particular GL Code.

fields.label: Gl Net Revenue
fields.description: GL Revenue NOT including Agency commission.

fields.label: Gl Gross Revenue
fields.description: GL Revenue including Agency commission.

fields.label: Gl Match Type
fields.description:
GLMatchType indicates how the GL configuration was selected:

GL_TYPE_AND_CLIENT_TYPE = Both GL Type and Client Type matched.
GL_TYPE_ONLY = GL Type matched and product Client Type was blank.
NO_MATCH = No matching GL configuration was found.

fields.label: Month Unique ID
fields.description:
Identifier using the Line Id with an appended .n 
This is the order details identifier.  However be aware that it is not a record unique identifier as if the GL has a split, it will be duplicated across the splits.
